segments.text: Candidates in Florida's governor's race,
Byron Donalds and David Jolly will not debate
each other ahead of the November election.
Democratic candidate David Jolly,
who you see on the left,
declined to debate Republican Byron Donalds,
who you see on the right.

the current campaign environment

Jolly says Donald's refused to accept previous debate invites.
The Florida GOP says Donald's challenged Jolly to 3 debates in July,
and Donald's accepted 3 statewide invitations on Friday.
They say Florida voters deserve the discussion,
and an empty podium will speak volumes if Jolly refuses to show up.
We did reach out directly to Donald's campaign for comment.
We'll let you know if we get a response.
